title: Pig dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- dance floor glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='38' ry='7' fill='#3a2a55'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <circle cx='84' cy='20' r='3' fill='#7ff0d0'/>
  <rect x='85.5' y='10' width='2' height='11' fill='#7ff0d0'/>
  <path d='M77 54 q4 -4 8 0' stroke='#7ff0d0' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='57' r='2.5' fill='#7ff0d0'/>
  <!-- left leg kicked up -->
  <rect x='30' y='68' width='9' height='16' rx='4' fill='#e88fb0' transform='rotate(-25 34 76)'/>
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='84' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#c96f92' transform='rotate(-25 27 84)'/>
  <!-- right leg planted -->
  <rect x='58' y='66' width='9' height='20' rx='4' fill='#e88fb0'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='87' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#c96f92'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#f7a8c4'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#ffd0e0'/>
  <!-- curly tail -->
  <path d='M26 52 q-9 -2 -7 -9 q2 -6 8 -4 q4 2 2 6' stroke='#e88fb0' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- arms dancing -->
  <rect x='18' y='36' width='8' height='18' rx='4' fill='#e88fb0' transform='rotate(35 22 45)'/>
  <rect x='74' y='32' width='8' height='18' rx='4' fill='#e88fb0' transform='rotate(-40 78 41)'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='38' r='5' fill='#c96f92'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='30' r='5' fill='#c96f92'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='19' fill='#f7a8c4'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M33 16 q-6 -12 6 -10 l4 10 z' fill='#e88fb0'/>
  <path d='M67 16 q6 -12 -6 -10 l-4 10 z' fill='#e88fb0'/>
  <path d='M35 13 q-3 -6 3 -5 l2 5 z' fill='#c96f92'/>
  <path d='M65 13 q3 -6 -3 -5 l-2 5 z' fill='#c96f92'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='35' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#ffd0e0'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='35' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#c96f92'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='35' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#c96f92'/>
  <!-- happy eyes -->
  <path d='M39 25 q3 -3 6 0' stroke='#5b2a44' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M55 25 q3 -3 6 0' stroke='#5b2a44' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='31' r='3' fill='#ff7fa8'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='31' r='3' fill='#ff7fa8'/>
</svg>
